live_preview.description: true = live JSON; false = saved animation (other JSON controls then have no effect).

strength.description: Range 0 to 1; default 1.0. Overall animated effect strength; zero gives the neutral cloner.

spacing_cm.description: Range 50 to 500; default 160.0. Grid spacing or spacing between rings.

wavelength_cm.description: Range 100 to 10000; default 1600.0. Distance between wave crests. Try 1800; near/below clone spacing the pattern can look irregular.

speed_hz.description: Range -2 to 2; default 0.25. Cycles per second, not percent. Try 0.5 (one cycle every 2 seconds); negative reverses travel; 0 freezes the wave.

phase_degrees.description: Range -360 to 360; default 0.0. Wave phase offset.

direction_degrees.description: Range -180 to 180; default 25.0. Direction in degrees; affects plane waves only.

base_scale.description: Range 0.1 to 3; default 0.7. Neutral clone scale multiplier.

scale_wave.description: Range 0 to 0.9; default 0.45. Wave-driven scale modulation relative to base scale.

rotation_degrees.description: Range 0 to 180; default 35.0. Wave-driven clone tilt.

spin_degrees_per_second.description: Range -360 to 360; default 45.0. Continuous clone spin.

noise_cm.description: Range 0 to 500; default 25.0. Deterministic per-clone bobbing amplitude.

noise_speed_hz.description: Range 0 to 2; default 0.5. Noise oscillation speed.

falloff_radius_cm.description: Range 100 to 20000; default 4500.0. Effect fades to zero at this radius. Try 12000 so most clones move; a small radius leaves outer clones still.

color_cycle_hz.description: Range 0 to 2; default 0.375. Prototype steps per second among three shared material configurations.
